g.text: Each switched vote changes the margin by 2. Threshold of 13 switches per section: standard deviation of the local residual of 1.67 p.p. (measured in this audit), 256 valid votes per section, |z| > 3. Region to

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5a5f66

g.text: the left of the threshold: an altered section does not stand out from its neighbors; it only shows up in aggregate (comparison with other offices, A22, not run) or by checking printed poll-receipts and the

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5a5f66

g.text: integrity test. Assumptions: random sample of sections; it does not describe how an alteration would be made.
